user.title: Set up SmartVan.io
user.description: Connect to your SmartVan.io devices via MQTT. Make sure MQTT is already configured in Home Assistant.

data_description.mqtt_prefix: The MQTT topic prefix used by your SmartVan.io devices. Default is 'smartvanio'. Only change this if you have a custom setup.

error.mqtt_not_available: MQTT integration is not configured. Please set up MQTT first.
error.invalid_prefix: Invalid MQTT prefix. Must not contain /, #, or + characters.

abort.already_configured: SmartVan.io is already configured with this prefix.
